title: Very easy name tag craft
description: A simple mod that adds custom crafting recipes for Name Tags and introduces a brand new villager trade to easily obtain them.
body:
Welcome to Very Easy Name Tag Craft!

Tired of exploring endless dungeons, mineshafts, or trading with specific villagers for hours just to name your favorite pets and mobs? This lightweight mod solves that problem completely!

Features:
Custom Crafting Recipes: Adds 2 new balanced, vanilla-friendly crafting recipes to easily create Name Tags using common materials directly at the crafting table.
New Villager Trades: Introduces alternative options for villagers, making Name Tags a fair and accessible trade item without the extra hassle.

Perfect for survival worlds, modpacks, and anyone who wants to save time. Install it on both client and server sides to enjoy!
